div.head: IV As 6.1
div.ab: ⁊ we gecwædon æt Ðunresfelda on þæm gemote, gif hwilc þeof oððe reafere gesohte þone cing oþþe hwylce cyrican ⁊ ðone biscop, þæt he hæbbe nigon nihta fyrst.
⁊ we gecwædon æt Ðunresfelda on þæm gemote, gif hwilc þeof oððe reafere gesohte þone cing oþþe hwylce cyrican ⁊ ðone biscop, þæt he hæbbe nigon nihta fyrst.
And we declared at the Council at Thundersfield, that if any thief or robber fled to the king, or to any church and to the bishop, he should have a respite of nine days.
Und wir bestimmten auf der Versammlung zu Thundersfield: wenn irgend ein Dieb oder Räuber den König um Zuflucht aufsucht oder irgend welche Kirche und den Bischof, dass er 9 Tage Frist erhalte.
And we determined at the assembly at Thundersfield: if any thief or robber seeks refuge with the king or any church and the bishop, that he receive 9 days' respite.
div.note: Fragment in H, appended to V As without a break (Schmid cites it as V As 4), but from the same source as IV As 6 (Latin above). ‘ðone biscop’ was originally ‘ærcebiscop’ according to the Latin (p. 172) and Grið 4 (Liebermann).
